summary: Sweeps line strips around an axis to generate surfaces of revolution. It can use an automatic pivot from each strip's first and last points, or explicit X/Y/Z axes and pivots, and outputs points, rows/columns, triangles, alternating triangles, or quads.

key_params.name: axis
key_params.note: Auto, X, Y, or Z revolve axis

key_params.name: autopivot
key_params.note: Use the line strip endpoints as pivot axis

key_concepts: Revolve POP sweeps each input line strip around an axis to create a separate surface of revolution.
Auto Pivot uses the first and last point of each line strip as that strip's axis, while X/Y/Z modes use explicit axes and pivot values.
Connectivity, division, texture, and normal controls decide whether the result is construction geometry, renderable triangles/quads, or attribute-rich surface data.
common_gotchas: Input must be meaningful line strips; loose points often produce unexpected surfaces.
Auto Pivot changes per strip, so multiple input strips can revolve around different axes.
Quad output is the default renderable surface path; line outputs are better for construction/debug views.
